- TOTAL revenue reached £74.9k in TW versus £48.6k in LW, a WoW gain of 54.2%.
- TOTAL revenue of £74.9k in TW compares with £20.7k in LY, a YoY gain of 261.4%.
- TOTAL volume in TW was 35,509 units across 1,803 orders.
- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT led TW at £2,941.59 (3.9% share), with REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER at £2,907.39 (3.9% share) and PARTY BUNTING at £2,730.41 (3.6% share).
- JUMBO BAG APPLES delivered £2,400.75 and SPOTTY BUNTING £2,207.23 in TW, with the top five products together holding 17.6% of TOTAL TW revenue.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT added £1,527.00 WoW, HOT WATER BOTTLE I AM SO POORLY added £1,349.25 WoW and JUMBO BAG ALPHABET added £1,271.76 WoW.
- SET OF TEA COFFEE SUGAR TINS PANTRY fell £1,834.20 WoW (-84.9%), SET OF 3 CAKE TINS PANTRY DESIGN fell £1,052.69 WoW and JUMBO BAG VINTAGE LEAF fell £543.24 WoW.
- JUMBO BAG STRAWBERRY rose 158.2% WoW and WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER rose 151.8% WoW.
